zh.what: 从微信取回文件时保留原文件名和后缀。文件被拒或发送结果未确认时，回复会说明实际情况。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: Files sent to WeChat keep their original names and extensions. Replies report when a file was refused or delivery could not be confirmed.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: 远端转写遇到暂时的连接故障时可在原时限内重试。切到本机转写的提示会自动收起，输入区高度保持稳定。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: Remote transcription can retry a temporary connection failure within the original time limit. The on-device fallback notice disappears on its own and leaves the composer in place.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: Telegram 文档和手机网页文件卡会保留长文件名的后缀。审批卡在手机本地到期时一并撤下等待状态点。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: Telegram documents and Web App file cards keep the extension on long filenames. The waiting indicator disappears when an approval card expires on the remote.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.

zh.what: Claude 后台子任务沿用经过核实的主人任务来源与审批档位。修复已配对网页和共享 Claude 提交反馈时的两种来路误判。
zh.action: 本条未提供操作步骤，请核实是否需要设置。

en.what: Claude background tasks keep the verified owner request and its approval level. Feedback from paired browsers and shared Claude is no longer rejected by two source checks.
en.action: No action steps were supplied for this change; check whether setup is needed.
